vars.prTitle: Datasources: accept an empty teamHttpHeaders object on create
vars.prBody: Creating a datasource fails with 403 when the payload contains `teamHttpHeaders` even if it has no rules, which happens for datasources exported from another instance. We now parse the field with datasources.GetTeamHTTPHeaders: malformed rules return 400, actual header rules are still forbidden (they must go through the LBAC rules API), and an empty object is dropped before saving.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "AddDataSource now dereferences the result of datasources.GetTeamHTTPHeaders (`teamHTTPHeaders.Headers`) without a nil check, but GetTeamHTTPHeaders (pkg/services/datasources/models.go) returns (nil, nil) when jsonData has no \"teamHttpHeaders\" key. That is the normal case for virtually every datasource create request with jsonData, so POST /api/datasources now panics with a nil pointer dereference (500 via the recovery middleware) for ordinary datasources. The handler must treat a nil result as \"no team headers\".", "severity": "High"}]
